detects.chromatic_class: the PBD class: lit member set per index, tint energies/ratio, tir fractions (entry measure x Fresnel through one kernel on a plate family sample)
detects.chromatic_diagnose: the colour verdict (kind/color/visible), every feature's criterion quantities, the threshold snapshot (N_RED/N_BLUE/EDGE_MIN_SHIFT_RAD/EDGE_SPREAD_PER_SHIFT/TINT_RATIO_MIN)
detects.dp_field_kinks: TIR-onset curve structure (step/margin/method, arc count, closed, ends) and D envelope per index; the constant circles pin their closed-form value (3-1-6, C06)
detects.dp_field_sample: D_P / gradient / U_P gate margins / A_P / T_P / w at fixed u: chain or index drift, gate-set change, corridor (entry measure) regression, weight-kernel mismatch
detects.dp_field_topology: partition bounds and counts, critical values, corner margin signatures, degenerate-fold fields, domain topology counts: partition escapes, corner Newton, slab-crease gates, chart audit
detects.focusing_classify: the kind-1 onset table and its labels (mechanism, profile, jacobian_focusing, multiplicity), gradient_norm_range, family_pinned
detects.wavelength_critical_table: onset displacement across n(lambda): the wavelength-critical preset (task 42.4)

cell.label: mc_field
cell.name: 4-8-7-5__mc_field
cell.rationale: the C05 cell on the beta crystal (from_lumice(3.0, [2,1,1,2,1,1]), the 659 config): a degenerate fold with the axis on the c axis, the partition [0, 50.161742, 120] deg, both intervals (2, 0, 2), the blade critical value 120 deg (the corpus' 119.99999999 is this value at grid resolution) and classify jacobian@blade (boundary_extremum/degenerate plus the slab circle)

input.d_p_convention: display delta (angle at the sun), radians, no 180-minus conversion

sample.method: strided valid subset of the antipodal Fibonacci lattice (s2_store.store_lattice), plus named interior anchors

input.weights_convention: twist-invariant pose with R u = probe sun [0, 0, 1]: A_P = entry_measure, T_P = fresnel_transmission_path, w = A_P T_P

a_p.basis: relative to max(1, |value|): the entry measure is a closed-form corridor polygon intersection in float64 (geometry.entry_measure): more arithmetic than the direction chain but no Snell amplification (areas are not divided by a discriminant square root), so 1e-10 relative leaves ~1e5 ulp

d_p.basis: float64 evaluation of the same closed-form refraction/reflection chain from bit-identical JSON inputs: a few ulp per interface (1e-12 leaves ~1e3 ulp of room), times 1/(2 sqrt(d)) for the smallest Snell discriminant d of the pose, the derivative of the refracted cosine sqrt(d) (kinematic_atol)

gradient_norm.basis: relative, J_perp = sigma_1 sigma_2 of the 2 x 3 right-trivialised residual Jacobian (contract section 5.4) is one derivative above the directions, so the direction tolerance's Snell amplification 1/(2 sqrt(d)) enters squared: |error| <= 1e-12 max(1, 1/(4 d)) max(1, |value|) per value (jacobian_rtol); measured: LI's AD value agrees with an independent central difference (h = 1e-6) to 6e-9 relative, and a 1e-14 rad pose nudge moves it by at most 2.5e-12 relative away from Snell boundaries (4e-8 at d ~ 1e-8)

margins.basis: absolute, per name in margin_names order: float64 evaluation of the same closed-form refraction/reflection chain from bit-identical JSON inputs: a few ulp per interface (1e-12 leaves ~1e3 ulp of room), times 1/(2 sqrt(d)) for the smallest Snell discriminant d of the pose, the derivative of the refracted cosine sqrt(d) (kinematic_atol)

t_p.basis: float64 evaluation of the same closed-form refraction/reflection chain from bit-identical JSON inputs: a few ulp per interface (1e-12 leaves ~1e3 ulp of room), times 1/(2 sqrt(d)) for the smallest Snell discriminant d of the pose, the derivative of the refracted cosine sqrt(d) (kinematic_atol)

valid.basis: exact; a lattice point of U_P in LI is valid, a backend's own gates decide its row the same way

w.basis: relative to max(1, |value|): the a_p tolerance, A_P times the T_P chain
